  de nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7185">bla ma dmar </rs><lb n="9a5"/> gyi drung du gsang sngags kyi chos rtso? gsan no |

  de ltar mtshan nyid slob pa'i dus su yang ¦ mi rtag pa rgyud la 'khrungs zhing | 'khor ba'i chos la skyo <lb n="9a6"/> shas che bar 'jig rten chos brgyad kun grol [READING SGROL] du shig shig 'gro ba byung zhing ¦ nges 'byung tshed pa yang thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa byung ngo | thugs rgyud la 'khrungs dang ¦ res 1 mtshan nyid kyi chos la 'chad nyan mdzad de skyes <lb n="9a7"/> bu mkhas pa'i grags pa yang thob ¦ mtshan nyid kyi chos rnams la yig 'jogs Ti ka yang mang du mdzad do | mkhas mchog yong su grags la phyag 'tshal bstod | ces pa'i don to |</seg></TEI>
